title: Audit CLI.md against reduced public CLI implementation
description:
Open the GitHub issue for context: https://github.com/openjobs-hq/openjobs/issues/3

Goal:
Audit `CLI.md` against the reduced public CLI implementation and align the docs with what is actually supported.

What this job should deliver:
- Review `CLI.md`
- Compare documented commands and examples against `packages/cli/bin/openjobs.js`
- Update the documentation so it matches the real public CLI surface

Requirements:
- Check whether documented commands are actually implemented in the reduced public CLI
- Remove, correct, or clearly mark unsupported flows or commands
- Review command examples for accuracy
- Preserve the documentation style while improving trustworthiness and precision
- Avoid broad product redesign; keep this scoped to doc accuracy for the public CLI

Definition of done:
- `CLI.md` has been audited against the current public implementation
- Unsupported or mismatched commands are corrected or removed
- Examples reflect the actual reduced public CLI command surface
- Any notable doc gaps are summarized in the submission notes

Submission expectations:
- Submit a GitHub branch or PR link if possible
- Include a short audit summary listing the main mismatches found
- Note any cases where code behavior is ambiguous and needs maintainer confirmation
